control_comparison.failed_target_submissions: failing target 2/2 dispatched quota failures before quarantine
control_comparison.smallest_demonstrated_difference: After two valid not_accepted responses, endpoint discovery treated response-level admission failure as transport failure and opened the endpoint circuit. The later three requests therefore failed before discovery could return a relay target. The two earlier target-eligibility records have no per-request admission event and cannot be narrowed beyond no lease/no submission.

demonstrated_root_cause.mechanism: Endpoint discovery used a circuit intended for transport reachability, but valid HTTP relay admission/capability outcomes were allowed to increment that circuit. Two ordinary target/admission failures therefore hid a reachable endpoint from later requests and converted a local response into global pre-dispatch relay_discovery_failed.
demonstrated_root_cause.why_tests_missed_it: The original admission tests exercised known scheduler state and the production run did not persist a private per-request admission event. No regression covered the boundary between a valid non-2xx relay response and endpoint reachability accounting until the forensic reproduction.
demonstrated_root_cause.two_unresolved_records: The Sora and Morrow opportunity-3 records stopped before a central lease and worker submission, but retained neither the exact candidate, reservation failure, reselect decision nor worker pre-grant event. Existing evidence proves known-not-dispatched, not a specific second defect.

repair_and_regression.change: Only transport/fetch failures call reportRelayFailure. A valid HTTP response, including a private not_accepted admission response, remains evidence that the endpoint is reachable and does not poison endpoint discovery.
repair_and_regression.regression: scripts/test-image-availability.ts: a valid not-accepted response does not poison endpoint discovery
repair_and_regression.before_fix: The focused regression failed: after two valid not_accepted responses, the third request became relay_discovery_failed.
repair_and_regression.after_fix: The focused regression passes; all three valid response attempts reach the endpoint and no request is replayed on another endpoint.

semantics_verified.reselect: The existing admission/pool implementation reselects another compatible healthy target within the same lifecycle when the current candidate is target-local and known unusable; request-local exclusions bound the candidates.
semantics_verified.wait: The existing bounded queue waits only for known compatible capacity that can be released before the original absolute deadline; the deadline is not reset.
semantics_verified.terminate: The existing path terminates invalid configuration, no valid execution path, ambiguous dispatch and post-generation uncertainty without replay. No new generic retry loop was added.
semantics_verified.runtime_authority: Discovery establishes candidate existence/capability; runtime ownership and reservations establish live occupancy; workload-specific runtime state establishes image/text eligibility; quarantine/cooldown excludes future work; the lifecycle owns cleanup. Refresh cannot erase live runtime ownership.

observability_gap.missing: Private per-request admission events for candidate selection, reservation failure, reselect classification and worker pre-grant boundary
observability_gap.safe_next_step: Add the smallest administrator-only event fields before a future qualification run if the two records must be distinguished. Do not generate traffic solely to fill this gap.
observability_gap.public_exposure: No provider, topology, worker, shard, credential or capacity detail is added to public errors or frontend data.

disposition.next_step: Keep Stars inactive. Deploy/reload only under separate release authorization, then obtain fresh positive capability evidence. Add private admission events before any future run that needs the two under-observed pre-dispatch records distinguished. Do not replay the five failures or issue the 24 unallocated opportunities.
